# Bajrang Stay Inn

> A quiet hotel stay in Kodinar, Gujarat, minutes from Somnath Temple and the Saurashtra coast. Comfortable rooms, free Wi-Fi, free parking, breakfast and a 24/7 front desk.

## Stay

- [Rooms](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/rooms): Room types with photos, amenities and nightly rates.
- [Amenities](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/amenities): What is included with every stay.
- [Gallery](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/gallery): Photos of the hotel and its rooms.

## Book and contact

- [Book a room](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/book): Send a booking request for your dates.
- [Contact](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/contact): Address, phone and directions.

## Travel guides

- [Guides](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/guide): Nearby places and trip ideas around Kodinar and Somnath.
- [Visiting Somnath from Kodinar](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/guide/visiting-somnath-from-kodinar): Day plan for Somnath Temple, Triveni Sangam and Prachi Tirth.
- [Gir National Park from Kodinar](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/guide/gir-national-park-from-kodinar): How to plan a Gir safari day trip.
- [A day trip to Diu from Kodinar](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/guide/diu-from-kodinar): Diu Fort, Nagoa Beach and what to know about the drive.
- [Mul Dwarka and Jamjir Waterfall](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/guide/mul-dwarka-and-jamjir-waterfall-from-kodinar): Two easy half-day trips close to Kodinar.
- [Best time to visit Kodinar and Somnath](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/guide/best-time-to-visit-kodinar-and-somnath): Season-by-season weather and sightseeing advice.
- [Three-day Saurashtra coast itinerary](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/guide/three-day-saurashtra-coast-itinerary-from-kodinar): A paced three-day plan from one base in Kodinar.
